# BackAI

> Open-source, fork-friendly AI-backend template. One clone gives a product
> a customer app, an operator dashboard, a Go API runtime, auth,
> multi-tenancy, API keys, an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway with cost
> tracking and budgets, storage, jobs, crons, webhooks, a secrets vault,
> billing, and AgentField-backed agents — all behind one base URL. Brand:
> BackAI. CLI: af-stack. Default app: SupportDesk AI. The repo is the
> product; most work is editing the checkout, not calling a hosted API.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): product positioning, quickstart, and the full feature tour
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent orientation — first 60 seconds, the four edit surfaces, invariants
- [Repo map](docs/repo-map.md): who owns each directory after a fork
- [af-stack Skill](skills/af-stack/SKILL.md): primitives table, boundaries, canonical build workflow
- [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md): env surface, personal vs saas mode
- [Install the CLI](docs/cli-distribution.md): how to get the `af-stack` binary

- [Demo mode](docs/demo-mode.md): running with no provider key
- [Guardrails](docs/guardrails.md): PII detection and policy
- [Realtime](docs/realtime.md): run subscriptions and live activity
- [Search](docs/search.md), [Embeddings](docs/embeddings.md), [Multimodal](docs/multimodal.md)
- [Tool adapters](docs/tool-adapters.md), [Sandbox adapters](docs/sandbox-adapters.md)
- [Feature flags](docs/feature-flags.md)
